notes: Preferences only, per story 42. What a party lets a partner owe, and how value may move, are agreements and signed permissions — they live with the tally and with trading settings, never here (path C)
`locale`, `displayUnit` and `unitStyle` follow the party; `appearance` belongs to the device in hand (steps 6-7)
`availableLocales` is what the app actually has. Path A: a party is told what is available rather than left with a half-translated app, so this lists only complete bundles — one, today
`priced` says whether the party has given the unit a rate (story 41). Choosing an unpriced unit as the display unit is path B: reachable by tapping, so it needs no variant of its own
No `empty` or `error` fixture: the story's `empty` is these same defaults unchanged, and its `error` states are both reached by interaction rather than by a different world
